baseline.method: Independent author DLSuR rerun, three measured repeats; method reference, no truth

metric_definition: NCC is uncentered cosine; NRMSE uses each quantity reference dynamic range. Each modulus component and every other quantity must pass separately. Forward metric is worst replicate RMS correlation residual.
numerical_tolerance_rationale: Two independent original runs agree exactly; 1e-5 dynamic-range tolerance permits float64 conditioning/optimizer differences without permitting scientific changes; fixed before local extraction.
